mapper.select: SELECT notice_id as noticeId, title, content, is_published as isPublished, published_at as publishedAt, created_at as createdAt FROM ADMIN_NOTICE WHERE is_published = TRUE ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ADMIN_NOTICE ( title, content, is_published, published_at, created_at ) VALUES ( #{title}, #{content}, #{isPublished}, CASE WHEN #{isPublished} = TRUE THEN NOW() ELSE NULL END, NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE ADMIN_NOTICE SET title = #{title}, content = #{content}, is_published = #{isPublished}, published_at = CASE WHEN #{isPublished} = TRUE THEN COALESCE(#{publishedAt}, NOW()) ELSE NULL END WHERE notice_id = #{noticeId}
